scope: Query/procedure semantic facts, separate from optional debug observations and proof certificates

concrete_causes.cause: Accepted summary application returns before creating/requesting a Unit. This is legitimate execution and must not be repaired with a fabricated Unit.
All procedure returns/outcomes are currently derived from source.units (plus special lazy creation bottom metadata); summary-only procedures have no semantic observation source.

function_exit looks up module.symbol in retained returns; it cannot distinguish unmaterialized procedure scope, unsupported producer facts, unreachable declarations, or omitted projection. Bulk empty dict is answered with global coverage.

Bridge records calls/table reads/box writes and returns flows; it publishes no handler/dispatcher exit records. Handler parameter source reads required by frozenLV02 are also absent, so return-map repair alone does not close fullgold.
Compatibility reexports only; actual query parser/retention are queries.py/result.py. A schema-only patch cannot solve this defect.

fact_key: producer_id(realUnitId or actual summary call identity, never fake Unit)
proposed_model.payload: Actual owned tuple of Flow poststates, return/raise/suspend completion facts and typed binding/heap access facts. Retain graphs internally; do not prematurely flatten fresh box/alias information to JSON.
proposed_model.wire_compatibility: Keep existing QueryAnswer status keys; use per-query coverage (not automatically global coverage) and an explicit retained query ledger for reasons/materialization/producer/dependency scope. Exact shape of optional ledger export needs root decision.
proposed_model.bulk_semantics: An empty payload is answered/closed only when ledger proves that the requested complete scope is genuinely empty. Missing/unsupported summary facts cannot become a complete empty result.
proposed_model.raise_only: A complete reached raise-only scope can answer Bottom normal-return with normal_exitFalse and exception metadata. This differs from a body never executed.
proposed_model.generic_contract: contracts/procedure_facts.py contains identity/scope DTOs and a generic finite FactSink[Payload] protocol; concrete Flow/Store observation ownership lives in analysis/observations, not in contracts and not in debug ObserverPort.

required_transactions: Replace a complete producer generation, not an append-only bag of stale facts. A unit visit can change observations even when its final value is equal; observation generation must not depend solely on _outcomes_equal.

Stage checked-summary fact batches during provider execution and publish only after the whole accepted application and final admission succeed. Discard a None/failed application batch. Existing immediate call/access side effects are a separate atomicity concern, not proof that a new fact batch may partially commit.

An interrupted or changed-entry producer cannot expose its previous exact value as covering the new scope. Retain diagnostics only, or mark per-scope partial/unavailable with explicit missing coverage.

Prepare epoch remapping together with HostStateBoundary using existing graph-admitted Flow tuples (no new arbitrary state metadata record). Prepare metadata/dependency invalidation separately, final checkpoint then assignment-only host+facts publication. Failed preparation leaves both unchanged.
Checked-summary proof/freshness observations must be invalidated on retired allocation identity or changed source/policy/model/dependency; remapping an ObjectId is not a new closed freshness proof.
Copy/parse/aggregate/materialize/project all facts under the same RunLedger. At zero budget, a fixed unavailable controller must not enumerate unbounded requested queries/functions.

minimal_file_leases.action: new generic FactSink and pure DTOs; no solver/provider imports
new owned procedure store, producer generation replacement and staged epoch preparation
narrow constructor/_solve/request_function/summary_context/reabstract ports; snapshot source input only after publication owner releases
optional finite staged semantic facts callback; old debug observation remains separate
prepare real handler/dispatcher exit and typed source access batch from accepted finite source contract; do not publish before whole application succeeds
read actual observation store instead of requiring Unit; integrate with held paid ownership receipts under publication owner coordination
_retain_query consults materialization/query scope and per-query coverage; preserve paid read/ownership guards
carry selectors/truncation separately from producer coverage; never infer missing fact from discarded output
read-only unless root chooses an explicit new ledger view; current parser already supports function_exit
capability adapter only: import actual native procedure facts if present, otherwise explicit unavailable; no synthetic return records

recommended_order: Q0 pure store/ledger contracts and prereg revision/epoch/empty-scope tests, with no runtime behavior change.
Q1 ordinary Unit producers and shared publication/query retention. Keep regular17, raise-only, lazy/unreached scope controls and observation disabled parity.

Q2 accepted L2 staged procedure observations plus checked finite source effects. Preserve frozenlv_function_exit completegold; this may require a narrow LLM01 atomic batch prerequisite, not an empty return-map patch.
Q3 Native adapter capability statuses and retained-only producer facts, then partial budgets/projections and transaction rollback tests.
Q4 immutable source-bound original52+LV6, query controls, fullquality and dependency-negative guards; no card closure by count.
independent_acceptance_preregistered: Actual regular f17 single versus bulk returns/outcomes with debug off/on and single-query-only request.
L2 exactfrozen identity original, box retained, dispatcher union with identical box ObjectId scopes and real effects from verified source semantics.
Declared uncalled versus unknown producer capability versus lazy body never executed, while raise-only and genuinely empty scope remain distinct.
Two producer generations with different return values replace the stale generation; an equal final module result must not hide changed function facts.
TypedObjectId/CellId/ReferenceKey remap of procedure snapshots preserves alias coverage and source labels; failed preparation does not publish a new ledger epoch.
Summary prepare that records one candidate then returnsNone/raises/budget-stops publishes no partial procedure batch.
Selectors and truncation change projection scope only; disabled debug events do not remove solver/semantic facts.
Cap0/lowcap, malformed/huge query/fact inputs, and stale dependency cases give bounded unavailable without fake closed empty scopes.
open_decisions: Root lease coordination with currently held paid publication/driver edits.
Whether the optional query ledger is retained internal wire metadata, a new explicit view, or a typed accessor; do not silently expand fixed QueryAnswer equality fixtures.
Full L2 handler effect completeness/atomicity and fresh allocation identity are cross-card prerequisites; do not falsely label QUERY01 complete while frozenLV02 still fails.
